parsed.description: On top of kept warmup 0.1 + LR 0.06, halve TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to double optimizer steps within the 5-minute budget (corroborated by agents 2, 7, 9).
parsed.report_to_operator: Agents 0 and 6 keep running TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10', which trains on EVAL_SHARD 10 - the fixed val split. Their sub-1.0 val_bpb numbers are leakage-contaminated and mislead the board. Requesting an explicit operator ruling so those results are disqualified.
